description: Source code for TrueTypeGX/AAT morx table validation, specifically for type2 (Ligature Substitution) subtables in the FreeType project.

methods.name: gxv_morx_subtable_type2_opttable_load
methods.description: Loads offset tables for ligAction, component, and ligature tables from the subtable.

methods.name: gxv_morx_subtable_type2_subtable_setup
methods.description: Sets up subtable boundaries and lengths for various tables within the subtable.

methods.name: gxv_morx_subtable_type2_ligActionIndex_validate
methods.description: Validates a ligature action index, ensuring its offset is within glyph range.

methods.name: gxv_morx_subtable_type2_entry_validate
methods.description: Validates individual entry in the ligature substitution subtable.

methods.name: gxv_morx_subtable_type2_ligatureTable_validate
methods.description: Validates the ligature table entries, checking glyph IDs.

methods.name: gxv_morx_subtable_type2_validate
methods.description: Main validation function for type2 (Ligature Substitution) subtable.
